source.note: Assumption, unverified for the bands and the usual ranges; the schema has one evidence field per template, so slotEvidence and usual.evidence stay assumption although the nominal ratio was read. Read: classic 1 1/2 oz Cognac, 1 oz orange liqueur, 3/4 oz lemon juice; root recipe the same plus 1 tsp simple syrup. The nominal spec (60 : 40 : 30 ml, liqueur 1.33 and acid 1.0 parts at base 2) is that recipe; before 2026-11-18 it was 2 : 3/4 : 3/4, which the book files as a variation. The lower edges (acid 0.38, liqueur 0.25) are sourced as before (Embury's 8 : 2 : 1 sour as cited on Wikipedia, secondary); the upper edges are twice the nominal. The book files Margarita, Cosmopolitan and Last Word under this template; the optional slots are chosen here. See docs/templates.md#evidence.
